title: 三州に共通する人気の名前
original: According to the Social Security Administration, what are the identical names that show up in the top five boy's names of 1975 for the states of Maine, Texas, and California?
original_scope: Full question from fixed official CSV; no omissions
japanese: 米国社会保障局（SSA）による1975年の男の子の名前の人気順位で、メイン州、テキサス州、カリフォルニア州のすべてで5位以内に入っている名前は何か。
explanation: 州ごとに人気の名前を上位5件ずつ取り出し、三つの一覧に共通する名前を求める。各州の順位が違っていても、5位以内に入っていれば候補になる。

source_record.problem: According to the Social Security Administration, what are the identical names that show up in the top five boy's names of 1975 for the states of Maine, Texas, and California?

title: 三つの巻すべてに登場する著者
original: Could you please provide a complete list of authors who published at least one article in each of the first three volumes (Volumes 1, 2, and 3) of the Journal of Machine Learning Research?
original_scope: Full question from fixed official CSV; no omissions
japanese: 機械学習の学術誌Journal of Machine Learning Researchの最初の3巻（第1・2・3巻）のそれぞれに、少なくとも1本の論文を発表した著者を全員挙げてほしい。
gold: Robert C. Williamson, Yoram Singer, David Maxwell Chickering
expected: Robert C. Williamson、Yoram Singer、David Maxwell Chickering
explanation: 各巻の論文の著者一覧を作り、三つの一覧に共通する人を探す。編集者として名前が載るだけの場合と、論文の著者である場合を分けて確認する。

source_record.problem: Could you please provide a complete list of authors who published at least one article in each of the first three volumes (Volumes 1, 2, and 3) of the Journal of Machine Learning Research?
source_record.answer: Robert C. Williamson, Yoram Singer, David Maxwell Chickering

title: 二つの条件を満たす洪水の年
original: I'm researching extreme weather in the United States. Between 2017 and 2021 (inclusive), which year saw flood-related fatalities in over 20 states, with over 100 total deaths (with all states combined)? This includes both flash flooding and river flooding. Use National Weather Service and NOAA data.
original_scope: Full question from fixed official CSV; no omissions
japanese: 米国の極端な気象を調べている。2017年から2021年までのうち、洪水による死者が出た州が20を超え、全州の死者数が合計100人を超えた年はいつか。鉄砲水と河川の氾濫をともに含め、米国国立気象局（NWS）と米国海洋大気庁（NOAA）のデータを用いる。
explanation: 2021年は22州で計146人。2017年も計136人だが、死者が発生したのは18州だった。死者の総数と州の数を同時に確かめる。

source_record.problem: I'm researching extreme weather in the United States. Between 2017 and 2021 (inclusive), which year saw flood-related fatalities in over 20 states, with over 100 total deaths (with all states combined)? This includes both flash flooding and river flooding. Use National Weather Service and NOAA data.

title: 二つの説明ページをつなぐ
original: By using the NHS website for “Shoulder Pain”, which of the possible causes of the condition creates symptoms like poor balance and coordination?
original_scope: Full question from fixed official CSV; no omissions
japanese: 英国の公的医療サービス（NHS）の「Shoulder Pain」のページを使い、肩の痛みの原因として挙げられているもののうち、バランスや動作の協調がうまくできないといった症状を伴うのはどれか。
explanation: 肩の痛みの原因一覧から関節の過可動性についての説明へ進む。関節過可動症候群の症状には、バランスや協調運動の問題が挙げられている。

source_record.problem: By using the NHS website for “Shoulder Pain”, which of the possible causes of the condition creates symptoms like poor balance and coordination?

title: 運送会社の営業費用の減少
original: Among Saia, Inc., Matson, Inc., and ArcBest Corporation, which company had the greatest reduction in operating expenses for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023? Use the SEC website and filings.
original_scope: Full question from fixed official CSV; no omissions
japanese: Saia, Inc.、Matson, Inc.、ArcBest Corporationのうち、2023年12月31日を期末とする会計年度に営業費用が最も大きく減少した会社はどれか。SECのウェブサイトと提出書類を用いる。
explanation: 各社の2023年と2022年の営業費用を同じ単位で比較する。ArcBestは約46.34億ドルから約42.55億ドルへ、約3.80億ドル減少。Matsonの約2.38億ドル減少を上回り、Saiaは増加していた。

source_record.problem: Among Saia, Inc., Matson, Inc., and ArcBest Corporation, which company had the greatest reduction in operating expenses for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023? Use the SEC website and filings.

title: 共著者から授業の担当者を探す
original: Which of Isabelle Darcy's (2012) coauthors on the article "Direct Mapping of Acoustics to Phonology: On the Lexical Encoding of Front Rounded Vowels in L1 English-- L2 French acquisition" has taught courses on both the German language and constructed languages at Indiana University-Bloomington?
original_scope: Full question from fixed official CSV; no omissions
japanese: Isabelle Darcyの2012年の論文「Direct Mapping of Acoustics to Phonology: On the Lexical Encoding of Front Rounded Vowels in L1 English-- L2 French acquisition」の共著者のうち、インディアナ大学ブルーミントン校でドイツ語と人工言語の両方の授業を担当したことがあるのは誰か。
explanation: 論文の共著者を確認してから、各人の担当授業を調べる。「人工言語」は、人が意図的に設計した言語を指す。

source_record.problem: Which of Isabelle Darcy's (2012) coauthors on the article "Direct Mapping of Acoustics to Phonology: On the Lexical Encoding of Front Rounded Vowels in L1 English-- L2 French acquisition" has taught courses on both the German language and constructed languages at Indiana University-Bloomington?

title: 首都以外の都市で開かれた万博
original: Consider all European cities that have ever hosted a World Expo (up to and including 2020) according to the Bureau International des Expositions (not Specialized Expos) but are not the capital of their respective country. List the year of the most recent World Expo hosted by each of those cities that are on the Iberian Peninsula.
original_scope: Full question from fixed official CSV; no omissions
japanese: 国際博覧会事務局（BIE）による2020年までのWorld Expoの開催都市から、その国の首都ではないヨーロッパの都市を考える。イベリア半島にある該当都市について、それぞれで最も最近開かれたWorld Expoの開催年を挙げよ。Specialized Expoは含めない。
explanation: 該当する開催都市はバルセロナとセビリア。World ExpoとSpecialized Expoの区分を確認し、開催年と都市を対応させる。

source_record.problem: Consider all European cities that have ever hosted a World Expo (up to and including 2020) according to the Bureau International des Expositions (not Specialized Expos) but are not the capital of their respective country. List the year of the most recent World Expo hosted by each of those cities that are on the Iberian Peninsula.

title: 画材と描かれた場所で絞る作品
original: Which of Georgia O’Keeffe's works at the Art Institute of Chicago, as of June 2024, were landscapes of New Mexico created before 1940 with oil painting?
original_scope: Full question from fixed official CSV; no omissions
japanese: 2024年6月時点のシカゴ美術館の所蔵品のうち、Georgia O’Keeffeが1940年より前に制作した、ニューメキシコの風景を描いた油彩作品はどれか。
gold: Red Hills with Flowers (1937), Black Cross, New Mexico (1929)
expected:
Red Hills with Flowers（1937年）
Black Cross, New Mexico（1929年）
explanation: 所蔵作品の作者、制作年、画材、描かれた場所を照合する。参照回答の2点は、1937年と1929年に制作されたニューメキシコの風景の油彩作品。

source_record.problem: Which of Georgia O’Keeffe's works at the Art Institute of Chicago, as of June 2024, were landscapes of New Mexico created before 1940 with oil painting?
source_record.answer: Red Hills with Flowers (1937), Black Cross, New Mexico (1929)

title: 二人分の身長を比較する
original: Which combined height is greater? Those of the two tallest players on the 2022-2023 Lehman College basketball team, or their counterparts on the 2023-2024?
original_scope: Full question from fixed official CSV; no omissions
japanese: レーマン・カレッジのバスケットボールチームで、2022–2023シーズンの身長が高い上位2人と、2023–2024シーズンの上位2人では、身長の合計はどちらが大きいか。
gold: The 2023-2024 Lehman College basketball team had the larger combined height for the tallest two players.

source_record.problem: Which combined height is greater? Those of the two tallest players on the 2022-2023 Lehman College basketball team, or their counterparts on the 2023-2024?
source_record.answer: The 2023-2024 Lehman College basketball team had the larger combined height for the tallest two players.

title: 受験率と平均点で州を選ぶ
original: Determine which states had an ACT participation rate of 50% or higher for the graduating class of 2023 and received an average composite score of 20 or above. What percentage of each state's students met the science benchmark?
original_scope: Full question from fixed official CSV; no omissions
japanese: 2023年の高校卒業者について、米国の大学進学適性試験ACTの受験率が50%以上、平均総合点が20点以上だった州を特定せよ。それぞれの州で、ACT受験者のうち理科の到達基準を満たしたのは何%だったか。
expected: ミネソタ州41%、サウスダコタ州41%
explanation: ミネソタ州の受験率は68%、平均総合点は20.8点。サウスダコタ州は59%、21.1点。どちらもACT受験者の41%が理科の到達基準を満たした。

source_record.problem: Determine which states had an ACT participation rate of 50% or higher for the graduating class of 2023 and received an average composite score of 20 or above. What percentage of each state's students met the science benchmark?
